wiki.title: Quadi
wiki.description: Roman-era Germanic kingdom near present-day Bratislava
wiki.extract: The Quadi were a Germanic people during the Roman era, who were prominent in Greek and Roman records from about 20 AD to about 400 AD. By about 20 AD they had a kingdom centred in the area of present-day western Slovakia, north of the Roman border on the Danube river.
